name: Katase Shinobu
source:
Popular young adult voice actor who became freelance after a dispute with her agency. She has a large number of adult fans and has several regular radio shows on the Internet.

Her blog is popular and she sometimes sings theme songs, but she does not show her face.

She would like to focus on dubbing for anime and foreign films. Her acting in actual sex scenes is not as polished as she would like it to be.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/injyokustudio2/index.html]official site[/url]]
